resources.string: Pushup Bird watches your head with the front camera and moves the bird to match. Prop the phone in front of you and play by doing pushups.\n\nVideo stays on this phone. Nothing is recorded, saved, or uploaded.
The camera is still off, so there is nothing to follow. Allow the camera for Pushup Bird in Settings, then come back.
The bird sits on the same line as your head. Lower into a pushup and it goes with you. If the camera loses your face, the bird holds still. It never drops on its own.
On-device face detection. Nothing is recorded.
